tools.name: Aline
tools.changelog: Update check and DesignPraise mark added. Same features as 2.1: line angle, custom reference point, Chain Drift with 15 ramps, Bounce Ease-In/Duration, Tangent Tighten.

tools.name: Compensate
tools.changelog: Dockable panel. Drag mode: drag a precomp's out edge to add or remove frames. Fixed frame blending, early-ending layers, start-time offset and time-stretch with trims.

tools.name: Notable
tools.changelog: Several notes, saved automatically. Copy to clipboard. Post as text layer, into the selected text layer, or as a comp or layer marker. A sketch per note; Sketch to Comp keeps proportions, smooths lines and rounds the ends.

tools.name: Bouncer
tools.changelog: One tool for overshoot and bounce. Live mode adds an expression with sliders in Effect Controls; Bake mode writes a damped-spring curve between selected keyframes and always lands on the end key.

tools.name: Precomp Kit
tools.changelog: Deep Duplicate (keeps effects, masks, parenting and mattes), Sync Names in either direction, and Delete & Clean for unused sources.

tools.name: Auff
tools.changelog: Dockable. Choose which comps it affects, exempt layers by search or from the timeline, turn audio off or back on in one undo step. No longer stops on layers without audio.

tools.name: Compyle
tools.changelog: Fixed Remove Selected, and closing the reduced project now never asks to save. Clear message if Reduce Project isn't available.

tools.name: Let's Be Guided
tools.changelog: Guide files remember their comp size and can scale to a different-sized comp. Clearing guides is one undo step. Works on older After Effects builds.

tools.name: FootLogWork
tools.changelog: Colour match samples a 16x16 grid in one pass (much faster, and each sample averages its cell). Now docks.

tools.name: Prop Up
tools.changelog: Now finds properties inside shape groups (it was checking a group type that doesn't exist) and no longer crashes when sorting.
